title: 2005 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: Joe had walked half way from home to school when he realized he was late. He ran the rest of the way to school. He ran \(3\) times as fast as he walked. Joe took \(6\) minutes to walk half way to school. How many minutes did it take Joe to get from home to school?

solutions.text:
Joe took \(6\) minutes to walk the first half of the distance.

He ran the second half, the same distance, at \(3\) times his walking speed, so that half took \(6\div3=2\) minutes.

His total time was \(6+2=8\) minutes.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Joe runs the same half-distance he previously walked.
Running three times as fast takes one third as much time.
